golden_reference_policy.source: The Vine live-good mobile topper is the golden visual/source baseline for the universal template.
forbidden_operations: deploying generated packages over protected reference Workers
using a target package to redefine the reference
golden_reference_policy.promotion_rule: A new innovation must first be proven against a non-live/generated candidate and then explicitly approved as a golden-source update before the Vine golden reference may be changed.

canonical_base.reason: User reset the package on 08/12/2026: the working Vine implementation is the base. The universal package must copy its structure and populate data only.

first_apply_target.reason: The Vine is the golden reference and must not be mutated during package extraction. A future apply target must be explicitly named before deployment can be enabled.

concession_policy.reviews: Reviews are required when a sourced review row exists. For lease-ups or newer properties with no sourced reviews, mobile_shell.reviews.present must be false, link_required false, the review row must be absent, and schema aggregateRating must be absent.
concession_policy.awards: Awards are required when sourced. If no sourced award exists, mobile_shell.awards.present must be false and assets empty; never render a placeholder award.
concession_policy.specials: Specials must be feed-backed. If no active feed special exists, mobile_shell.promo.present must be false and the promo bar must be absent; never scrape the Specials page or reuse stale marketing copy.
concession_policy.content_blocks: The first two source-owned content blocks are mandatory unless an approved exception file names the missing block, replacement source, approver, date, and target property.
concession_policy.desktop: Desktop remains native passthrough with analytics/identity guards only. No desktop topper or all-device shell is allowed without explicit current approval.
concession_policy.performance_parity: The mobile package must preserve the proven Vine high-score profile. A 90+ score is only a minimum floor; the live package also requires the reference-parity PSI gate and strict initial asset/request budgets.
concession_policy.assets: Hero and first two content-block assets must be generated by the canonical asset builder, uploaded through the governed R2 uploader, served same-origin from R2, and pass byte, content-type, immutable-cache, and R2-marker readback checks.

deployment_gate.reason: Champions Green is the base reference and must not be mutated by package extraction. A package can be applied only by this gated runner after a separate target is explicitly selected.
